metadata.description: Azure region for all resources
Name for the App Service (plan will be <name>-plan, key vault will be <name>-keys)
App Service Plan SKU
Name of the Azure Container Registry to create
Name of the Storage Account to create
Name of the blob container for uploads
Name of the PostgreSQL Flexible Server to create
Database name
PostgreSQL admin username
PostgreSQL admin password
PostgreSQL application user password — used by the app at runtime (not for migrations)
PostgreSQL compute SKU
PostgreSQL compute tier
NextAuth.js secret — generate with: openssl rand -base64 32
Public URL of the App Service, e.g. https://<name>.azurewebsites.net
Google OAuth client ID (leave empty to disable)
Google OAuth client secret
Microsoft Entra ID client ID (leave empty to disable)
Microsoft Entra ID client secret
Microsoft Entra ID tenant ID
Docker image tag to deploy
Email address of the initial admin user, seeded automatically on first container start
Name of the Service Bus queue for upload jobs
Shared secret the Azure Function sends as X-Worker-Secret when calling /api/upload/process. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
Shared secret the scheduled retention job sends as x-worker-secret when calling /api/admin/retention/run. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
AES-256 key (base64, 32 bytes) used to encrypt MFA TOTP secrets at rest. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Leave empty to disable local-account MFA.
Data residency for Azure Communication Services (email). e.g. United States, Europe, Canada.
Custom email sender domain (e.g. mail.porterdata.com) for deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC). Leave empty to use the Azure-managed test domain (lands in spam).
Set true ONLY after the custom email domain's DNS records are published and verified in ACS. Gates linking/sending so the first deploy can create the domain and emit DNS records without failing.
Days after last modification before an upload blob moves to Cool tier; -1 to disable
Days after last modification before an upload blob moves to Archive tier; -1 to disable
Monthly cap (GB) on malware scanning to bound cost; -1 for unlimited
Log Analytics / App Insights retention in days (first 90 are free)
Daily ingestion cap (GB) on the Log Analytics workspace; -1 for no cap
